description: Fleet-level view: how test suites are trending per repository and server version, which tests appeared or vanished, and whether our metrics storage stays healthy. For per-test inspection use the Repo Health dashboard.

spec.description: How many repositories sent test results recently.
spec.title: Repos reporting

spec.description: Distinct test names that reported in the selected recent window. A test that runs against several server versions is counted once here — the "Tests × server versions" panel counts every combination separately.
spec.title: Unique tests

spec.description: Every combination of test name and server version seen in the last 30 days; each combination is tracked (and billed) separately. Healthy: roughly Unique tests × number of server versions. If this number grows while Unique tests stays flat, old names keep being replaced by new ones — see the "Are test names stable?" panels below.
spec.title: Tests × server versions (30 days)

spec.description: Total time a full test run takes, per repository and server version. A rising line means CI is getting slower overall, even if no single test trips the regression alarm.
spec.title: Total test time per repo

spec.description: Number of tests per repository and server version. Jumps reveal suite growth; sustained climbing without new tests means unstable test names minting duplicate entries.
spec.title: Test count per repo

spec.description: Tests that appeared recently and have no earlier history (capped at 200). Expect a wave when a repo or server version is first onboarded.
spec.title: New tests (first seen in the last $recent)

spec.description: Tests that had history but no recent runs - deleted, renamed, or a server version dropped from the CI matrix.
spec.title: Disappeared tests (per repo)

spec.description: Metric series that reported within the last 20 minutes — what Grafana Cloud counts as active for billing. Near zero between CI runs is expected and keeps the bill low.
spec.title: Metric series billed now

spec.description: The slowest tests across the fleet - typical (median) duration over the recent window; when a test runs against several server versions, the bar shows its slowest one. Click a bar to open the test in the Repo Health drilldown.
spec.title: Top 20 slowest tests

spec.description: Tests that gained the most time compared with their own history - biggest absolute slowdowns across the fleet. Click a bar to open the test in the Repo Health drilldown.
spec.title: Top 20 biggest slowdowns (recent vs baseline)

spec.description: Tests that got faster compared with their own history - the other side of the slowdowns panel. The value is time saved per run. Click a bar to open the test in the Repo Health drilldown.
spec.title: Top 20 biggest speed-ups (recent vs baseline)

spec.expr:
count by (vcs_repository_name) (
    (max by (test_id, vcs_repository_name, server_version) (quantile_over_time(0.5, cae_v16_test_duration_seconds{vcs_repository_name=~"$repository", server_version=~"$server_version", vcs_repository_ref_name=~"$branch"}[$recent])))
  /
    clamp_min(max by (test_id, vcs_repository_name, server_version) (quantile_over_time(0.5, cae_v16_test_duration_seconds{vcs_repository_name=~"$repository", server_version=~"$server_version", vcs_repository_ref_name=~"$branch"}[$baseline] offset $recent)), 0.05)
  > 1.5
  and
    (max by (test_id, vcs_repository_name, server_version) (quantile_over_time(0.5, cae_v16_test_duration_seconds{vcs_repository_name=~"$repository", server_version=~"$server_version", vcs_repository_ref_name=~"$branch"}[$recent])))
  -
    (max by (test_id, vcs_repository_name, server_version) (quantile_over_time(0.5, cae_v16_test_duration_seconds{vcs_repository_name=~"$repository", server_version=~"$server_version", vcs_repository_ref_name=~"$branch"}[$baseline] offset $recent)))
  > 1
  and
    (max by (test_id, vcs_repository_name, server_version) (count_over_time(cae_v16_test_duration_seconds{vcs_repository_name=~"$repository", server_version=~"$server_version", vcs_repository_ref_name=~"$branch"}[$baseline] offset $recent)))
  >= 10
)
or
0 * count by (vcs_repository_name) (last_over_time(cae_v16_test_run_duration_seconds{vcs_repository_name=~"$repository", server_version=~"$server_version", vcs_repository_ref_name=~"$branch"}[$recent]))

spec.description: How many tests were flagged as regressed at each point in time, per repository (same rule as the regression table). Every reporting repository shows a line anchored at zero; a spike means something landed in that repo, and it decays as the new level becomes the norm.
spec.title: Regressed tests over time

spec.description: The distribution of all test durations over time: the typical test (p50), the slow tail (p95), and the single slowest. A rising p95 with a flat p50 means the slow tests are getting slower even though most tests are fine.
spec.title: Test duration spread

spec.description: Test health beyond duration: how many tests failed (incl. errors) or were skipped in each run, per repository. A creeping skipped count usually means tests being quietly disabled instead of fixed.
spec.title: Failed & skipped tests over time

spec.description: How many test runs each repository uploaded per day (matrix jobs count separately). If a repository's cadence drops, its baselines age and the regression rule loses confidence - check this when a repo's numbers look stale.
spec.title: CI uploads per day

spec.expr:
100 * sum by (vcs_repository_name, server_version) (
    last_over_time(cae_v16_test_run_duration_seconds{vcs_repository_name=~"$repository", server_version=~"$server_version", vcs_repository_ref_name=~"$branch"}[1d])
  )
/ sum by (vcs_repository_name, server_version) (
    last_over_time(cae_v16_test_run_duration_seconds{vcs_repository_name=~"$repository", server_version=~"$server_version", vcs_repository_ref_name=~"$branch"}[1d] offset 21d)
  )
- 100

spec.description: Percent change of a repository's total CI test time compared with three weeks earlier, one line per server version. Hovering around 0% is healthy. A steady climb means the whole suite is getting slower little by little — the kind of creep no single-test alarm catches. Empty until three weeks of history exists.
spec.title: Total test time: change vs 3 weeks ago

options.content:
### Are test names stable?

A test whose name embeds a run-varying value (a timestamp, a random id, a port) looks brand-new on every run: history never accumulates, baselines never mature, and every run adds paid metric series. The action warns about recognizable patterns when results are submitted; these panels watch for everything else by observing the names themselves.

spec.expr:
count by (vcs_repository_name) (
      max by (test_id, vcs_repository_name, server_version) (last_over_time(cae_v16_test_duration_seconds{vcs_repository_name=~"$repository", server_version=~"$server_version", vcs_repository_ref_name=~"$branch"}[1d]))
    unless
      max by (test_id, vcs_repository_name, server_version) (last_over_time(cae_v16_test_duration_seconds{vcs_repository_name=~"$repository", server_version=~"$server_version", vcs_repository_ref_name=~"$branch"}[7d] offset 1d))
  )
or
  0 * count by (vcs_repository_name) (last_over_time(cae_v16_test_run_duration_seconds{vcs_repository_name=~"$repository", server_version=~"$server_version", vcs_repository_ref_name=~"$branch"}[1d]))

spec.description: How many test names appeared for the first time, per repository. Spikes right after merging new tests are normal. A line that never returns to zero means test names contain values that change on every run (timestamps, random ids) — each run then looks like a set of new tests. A repository's first days here show its whole test suite as new, which is accurate.
spec.title: New test names per day

spec.expr:
count by (vcs_repository_name) (
      (sum by (test_id, vcs_repository_name, server_version) (count_over_time(cae_v16_test_duration_seconds{vcs_repository_name=~"$repository", server_version=~"$server_version", vcs_repository_ref_name=~"$branch"}[7d])) == 1)
    unless
      max by (test_id, vcs_repository_name, server_version) (last_over_time(cae_v16_test_duration_seconds{vcs_repository_name=~"$repository", server_version=~"$server_version", vcs_repository_ref_name=~"$branch"}[1d]))
  )
or
  0 * count by (vcs_repository_name) (last_over_time(cae_v16_test_run_duration_seconds{vcs_repository_name=~"$repository", server_version=~"$server_version", vcs_repository_ref_name=~"$branch"}[1d]))

spec.description: Test names with exactly one recorded run in the last 7 days, ignoring tests added within the last day (a genuinely new test starts with one run). Healthy value: 0. A persistent count means names change between runs, so each name is seen exactly once and then never again.
spec.title: Test names that never repeat

spec.expr:
max(
    count by (vcs_repository_name) (last_over_time(cae_v16_test_duration_seconds[30d]))
  - count by (vcs_repository_name) (last_over_time(cae_v16_test_duration_seconds[3d]))
)
or vector(0)

spec.description: Test + server version combinations seen in the last 30 days but not in the last 3 days, worst repository shown (ignores the filters above). 0 means every name from the past month is still reporting — names are stable. A rising number means names keep being replaced: either tests were renamed or removed (fine, ages out within 30 days) or names change on every run (fix the test names).
spec.title: Test name stability check
